description: Declarative classification rules for West Sussex County Council spending rows. WSCC publishes a mix of yearly XLSX and monthly CSV files (9 cols: Body Name, Service Label, Service Division Label, Organisational Unit, Expenditure Category, Date, Capital and Revenue, Supplier name, Total) covering Apr 2022 onwards. The 2024-25 file is marked '_redacted' indicating active Care Act / GDPR redaction is applied. Default is procurement_paid. P-card aggregator entries stay as procurement_paid because they represent legitimate spend (just routed through the card provider).

match.supplier_regex: ^(\[REDACTED\]|REDACT(ED)?([ \-,].*)?|NAME WITHHELD|PAYMENT TO AN INDIVIDUAL|PAYMENT TO INDIVIDUAL|PRIVATE INDIVIDUAL|INDIVIDUAL)$

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions covering ASC direct payments, foster carer / SGO allowances, CYP direct payments. WSCC uses the 'PAYMENT TO AN INDIVIDUAL' literal as their redaction label rather than 'REDACTED'. Lawfully unnamed — not third-party procurement.
West Sussex Pension Fund — LGPS scheme administered by WSCC itself. Money moving inside the council group, not external procurement.

match.supplier_regex: ^(ADUR DISTRICT COUNCIL|ARUN DISTRICT COUNCIL|CHICHESTER DISTRICT COUNCIL|CRAWLEY BOROUGH COUNCIL|HORSHAM DISTRICT COUNCIL|MID SUSSEX DISTRICT COUNCIL|WORTHING BOROUGH COUNCIL)$

rules.reason: County→district pass-throughs: Disabled Facilities Grant allocations (statutory under HGCR Act 1996 s.23), concessionary travel reimbursements (Transport Act 2000 s.149), BCF s.75 pooled budget transfers. WSCC has no procurement discretion over these flows — they are formula-driven statutory passes to the lower tier.

match.supplier_regex: ^(SUSSEX PARTNERSHIP NHS FOUNDATION TRUST|UNIVERSITY HOSPITALS SUSSEX NHS FOUNDATION TRUST|WESTERN SUSSEX HOSPITALS NHS FOUNDATION TRUST|NHS SUSSEX ICB|NHS WEST SUSSEX CCG|NHS COASTAL WEST SUSSEX CCG)$

rules.reason: BCF s.75 pooled budget transfers to NHS commissioning bodies + trust reimbursements for jointly-commissioned services (Section 75 NHS Act 2006). Legally ring-fenced.
